dct_description_sm: The purpose of this data collection is to improve understanding of the presence and transport of microplastics in Arctic nearshore and coastal waters, with a focus on regions of importance to Northern Communities. The data are intended to support communityinformed assessment of microplastic distribution, contribute to national microplastics monitoring efforts, and inform numerical models that simulate microplastic transport under varying environmental conditions. Results from this work will support local, regional, national, and international research on plastic pollution in Arctic aquatic systems and provide an evidence base for future monitoring and decisionmaking.
dct_title_s: POLARIS Microplastics Sampling in the Kuukpak River and Beaufort Sea - 2026-2027
